Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

The room is filled with officials, reporters, and cameras. A large banner reads "WORLD RECORD HOLDER" in bold letters. At the center of the room, a frail but determined 127-year-old man, GEORGE, stands proudly, his eyes shining with tears. He is presented with a certificate and a gold medal.

OFFICIAL
Ladies and gentlemen, please welcome the newest world record holder, GEORGE, for being the oldest human to ever live!

The room erupts in applause as George smiles, his face etched with joy and gratitude.

CUT TO:

INT. GEORGE'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

George lies in bed, his eyes fixed on the ceiling. He takes a deep breath, and a faraway look creeps into his eyes.

GEORGE (V.O)
I Remember Reading About This Theory When I Was Young...

He begins to speak to himself, his voice barely above a whisper.

GEORGE (V.O)
Quantum Immortality. It Said That If You Were Born, You Would Live Forever. That Every Time You Died, You Would Reincarnate Into A New Body, And The Universe Would Keep Creating New Realities For You To Live In.

As he speaks, his eyes glaze over, and his voice becomes a monotone drone.

GEORGE (V.O)
I Never Thought Much Of It Back Then. But Now, As I Lie Here, I Wonder... What If It's True?

George's eyes snap back into focus, and his voice rises to a fevered pitch.

GEORGE (V.O)
What If I'm Not Really Dead? What If I'm Just Reincarnating Into A New Reality? What If I've Been Living Forever, And I Just Don't Remember?

The room begins to spin, and George's voice becomes a cacophony of despair.

GEORGE (V.O)
I'M NOT OLD, I'M IMMORTAL! I'M NOT DYING, I'M REINCARNATING! I'M NOT ALIVE, I'M JUST... JUST... JUST...

George's body begins to shake, and he collapses onto the bed, his mind shattered by the weight of his own immortality.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

INT. GEORGE'S BEDROOM - LATER

George lies in bed, his eyes wide open, his face contorted in a mixture of terror and despair. He is no longer the 127-year-old man who received the world record; he is a broken, shattered shell of a man, consumed by the crushing weight of his own immortality.

GEORGE (V.O)
I'M NOT ALIVE. I'M NOT DEAD. I'M JUST... JUST... TRAPPED IN THIS ENDLESS LOOP OF REINCARNATION.

The camera zooms out, and the room fades to black, leaving the audience to wonder: is George truly immortal, or is he just lost in a sea of madness?
